input.rationale: Compliant at the preferred position: no non-solicitation, no-hire or inducement covenant binds Bluefly anywhere in the Agreement. § 14.8 Personnel — the expected home for such a restraint — addresses only each party's supervision, direction and control of its own personnel, IBM's right to determine assignment of its personnel, and IBM's right to subcontract to Subcontractors and Affiliates; it contains no "shall not solicit", "employ or engage", "no-hire" or "induce ... to leave" language. Document-wide searches for solicit, hire, employ, employment, engage, induce, recruit, personnel and "shall not" return no hiring or solicitation restraint; the only "shall not" obligations on Bluefly are the no-resale covenant (§ 14.11) and interpretive/waiver provisions. Because the preferred position is the absence of any non-solicit on the Customer, this omission favors our party and maps to compliant rather than missing, so no redline and no counterparty comment are warranted. The deterministic sub-checks (12-month duration limit; general-solicitation carve-out) fail vacuously — there is no covenant whose duration or carve-outs could be measured — and do not undercut compliance. Internal negotiation guidance only: if IBM later proposes a non-solicit, hold to the fallback — mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from the end of their involvement, with carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches, and no no-hire.
